- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong recognition and checking skills
- Good computer literacy
- Basic data entry experience
- The ability to work confidently with files, information and computer systems
- The ability to accurately interpret handwriting
- A methodical and organised approach to work
- The ability to work quickly while maintaining accuracy
- A reliable and hardworking attitude
- The ability to work independently
- Good communication skills
- The ability to work well as part of a friendly team
- Previous administrative or data entry experience is beneficial but not essential
- A willingness to learn full training will be provided

Accuracy Matters

This role is perfect for someone who naturally spots the little things that others might miss.

You'll be working through large volumes of artwork, so you'll need to stay focused and consistent, even when tasks become repetitive. Getting names right and identifying potential issues before artwork goes to print is essential.

The environment can be busy and high-demand, but you'll be joining a friendly and supportive team where everyone works together towards a common goal.

If you enjoy working to targets, take pride in accurate work and like the satisfaction of knowing you've made a real difference to the end product, this could be a great role for you.

You'll become part of a welcoming team working on exciting fundraising projects, with the opportunity to gain valuable experience in data entry, administration, content management and artwork processing.
